‘Shameless venality’: how a flurry of lawsuits has thwarted Trump’s self-enrichment schemes

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/15/trump-self-enrichment-lawsuits

Courts have issued stinging rebukes to president’s ‘blatant’ financial ploys as pro-democracy groups defend ‘government of laws, not of men’ pillar.

Donald Trump’s legal and political ploys to increase his wealth and boost Republican electoral prospects have fueled lawsuits by non-partisan groups, prompting federal judges to issue stinging rejections to some of the president’s schemes.

Several lawsuits were filed in 2026 against Trump’s schemes to benefit his bottom line by reducing potential tax liabilities, boosting his Truth Social platform financially by offering big investors early access to his posts, and helping Republicans by using federal funds to pay for highly partisan ads touting Trump’s record in the run-up to the midterm elections, in which Republicans suffered a heavy defeat.

The major lawsuits against Trump’s financial ploys have been the handiwork of several nonpartisan groups including Democracy Defenders Fund and the Campaign Legal Center.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in response, judges in florida and new york used strong language to condemn and help nullify some of trump’s financial stratagems. Florida judge Kathleen Williams castigated a Trump scheme backed by the justice department to settle a $10bn lawsuit he filed against the Internal Revenue Service over an old leak of his tax information to the New York Times.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, williams ruled that the trump backed deal to set up a $1. 8bn slush fund to pay alleged victims of political persecutions under Joe Biden and giving him immunity from IRS audits before May 2026 was “premised on deception” and a “fraud against the court”.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a separate legal blow to trump in the closing weeks of the campaign, the president was rebuked by a federal judge in new york, for channeling $20m of public funds to run ads touting his administration’s achievements. The ads were widely attacked as campaign ads and propaganda.

Former judges and ex-DoJ lawyers say that he Trump moves to boost his bottom line and political drives with backing from DoJ lawyers exemplify various kinds of Trump “corruption”.

Berdasarkan laporan, stacey young, a former doj lawyer who set up justice connection last year as a network to defend the justice department workforce and the rule of law, told the guardian: “the justice department’s leadership believes it has one chief client: president trump. They have allowed him to use the department to protect his financial interests, punish his enemies, and reward his friends.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “thanks to the efforts of some of the country’s best litigators, the people of the united states are pushing back and standing up for the ideal that we remain a government of laws, not of men. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa further, retired federal appeals court judge j michael luttig said: “the courts have recently begun to strike down trump’s countless schemes of blatant and shameless venality and corruption in the forms of self-enrichment, bribery, and extortion. That is the through-line of these three cases and the numerous other cases to come. ”.

For Luttig, the court rebuffs are part of a broader trend of federal courts also rejecting as unconstitutional major presidential initiatives including tariffs and birthright citizenship.

Berdasarkan laporan, luttig’s analysis was underscored by a july lawsuit filed by democracy defenders fund and a coalition of 35 ex-judges, including luttig, to kill a key piece of trump’s proposed settlement of his $10bn lawsuit against the irs by establishing a $1. 8bn fund to pay alleged victims of political persecution that could have helped some January 6 Capitol rioters.

Diungkapkan bahwa the doj dropped the slush-fund idea after williams ruling and some political blowback by congress. But despite Williams’s legal objections and sharp criticism from Democratic senators, including Elizabeth Warren of Massachusetts, a provision is still in effect providing immunity to Trump, his family and the Trump Organization from investigations and prosecutions of past tax matters by the IRS as compensation over a leak of his tax returns.

In her ruling, Williams charged that the plaintiffs initiated the lawsuit “for an improper purpose – to gain the imprimatur of judicial legitimacy for a ‘settlement’ that had no viable basis in law or fact”.

Diungkapkan bahwa williams’s scathing opinion in mid-july noted that trump was on both sides of the issue and that the court itself was perhaps “the victim of fraud”. Williams concluded that the plaintiffs had acted in bad faith by “collusively filing a lawsuit with claims subject to multiple dispositive defenses solely to provide cover for a collusive settlement”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, citing language from an earlier ruling, williams said “this case is part of mr trump’s pattern of misusing the courts to serve political purposes”. In summary, Williams wrote, acidly, that the plaintiffs “pursued this lawsuit in bad faith for the improper purpose of dishonestly advancing a political narrative”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, trump’s lawyers in late july said they would appeal the williams order. In late September, a federal appeals court for the 11th circuit rejected a request from Trump and his lawyers to immediately lift sanctions that Williams imposed in response to the settlement Trump and the DoJ backed over the leak of his tax returns.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in its ruling, the appeals court denied a request by two trump lawyers, alejandro brito and daniel epstein, to pause sanctions against them over their handling of his $10bn lawsuit against the irs. The court ruled the lawyers had not demonstrated they would succeed in challenging finding that they acted in bad faith.

In another legal blow for Trump, two restraining orders were issued in October by district judge Jennifer Rochon in New York to stop his use of public funds for financing campaign style ads after Campaign Legal Center Action representing Common Cause, along with Public Integrity Project Action and Democracy Forward sued.

In her second emergency order on 30 October, Judge Rochon ruled that three ads could no longer run using government funds on Instagram and two other sites since they were “purely partisan”.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the ads echoed trump’s dubious claim that if republicans maintained control of congress, all americans would receive $5,000. The three ads Rochon ordered removed were headlined “$5,000 to Americans” the “Cost of Socialism” and “Every Democrat Voted against No Tax on Tips”.

Shortly before Rochon’s first ruling, Trump in a Truth Social post on 5 October defended using government funds for the ads and blithely stated that tapping public funds was “rather standard”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but with growing criticism, including from some republicans, trump announced he would pay for them himself from his political fundraising operation. The justice department also tried to forestall the first restraining order by asserting that “the alleged offending conduct will end tomorrow”.

Diungkapkan bahwa renata o’donnell, a senior legal counsel with campaign legal center who worked on the case, told the guardian: “the department of homeland security used $20m in taxpayer dollars to pay a private ad agency for airtime for government-created propaganda. This is blatantly illegal. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa o’donnell added: “in direct violation of the law, white house staff, whose salaries are paid with taxpayer dollars, were creating propaganda, including ads that promised people $5,000 to vote republican. ”.

In another pending legal battle that courts have yet to rule on, Democracy Defenders Fund filed a lawsuit with the San Francisco city attorney, the Washington Litigation Group and Platkin LLP to block a Trump financial gambit to offer special early access to his Truth Social posts to users who pay a fee as high as $100,000 per month to the parent company of Truth Social.

The lawsuit was filed in mid-September against Trump Media and Technology Group, which operates and owns Truth Social.

San Francisco city attorney David Chiu asked the San Francisco superior court to bar Trump Media from offering its new service, dubbed “Trump API”, or a similar one, plus provide monetary damages for violating the public trust and the state’s unfair competition law.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “trump media created a marketplace that enables insider trading, which trump directly profits from,” chiu said in a statement. “This scheme turns the public trust into private profit. It is corruption, plain and simple. ”.

A Trump Media spokesperson ridiculed the lawsuit when it was filed, charging that “the people of California should outsource their future lawsuits to AI chatbots who, unlike the leftwing activists masquerading as attorneys who filed this lawsuit, will grasp the basic distinction between public and nonpublic information”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, david ogden, a senior counsel with ddf who has worked on the case, noted that “congress made clear that the president, like any public servant, shouldn’t be permitted to profiteer off of special access to government information. It’s a violation of the public trust and it’s important that it be stopped. ”.

In the eyes of Barbara McQuade, former US attorney for eastern Michigan, who now teaches law at the University of Michigan, the different court rulings against Trump’s financial ploys reveal his penchant for “personal enrichment” and political ploys during his presidency.

Berdasarkan laporan, “it seems that trump has no shame about using his office for personal enrichment. We can’t count on his own conscience, ethics or advisers to check his worst instincts, but the courts have seen through his various schemes, from his slush fund to his use of taxpayer funds for political ads. ”.

#672. Trump administration planning to reimburse doctors treating vaccine ‘injury’

📅 15 Nov 2026

Trump administration planning to reimburse doctors treating vaccine ‘injury’

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/15/vaccine-policy-rfk-jr-trump-administration

Experts warn that sweeping changes elevate health secretary RFK Jr’s anti-vaccine agenda and personal profit.

The Trump administration is finalizing a rule to reimburse doctors who diagnose, treat and counsel patients with side effects from vaccines in what experts believe is an attempt to undermine trust in vaccines and to create an evidence base on their purported risks.

Robert F Kennedy Jr, the secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), also announced the creation of a vaccine “injury” research center at the National Institutes of Health and has sought to reshape the Vaccine Injury Compensation Program (VICP) – actions that point to Kennedy’s longtime activism against vaccination as well as the profits he and his network have made from vaccine lawsuits.

Kennedy and his allies have also profited from growing misinformation peddled through books, paid speaking events and the supplement industry.

Diungkapkan bahwa “i do think he’s a real ideologue – he really believes in this,” said dorit reiss, professor of law at uc law san francisco. But Kennedy and his allies are likely “very happy to make money doing it”, she said.

Peter Hotez, professor and dean of Baylor College of Medicine’s National School of Tropical Medicine, agreed, saying Kennedy’s actions are likely a combination of “being an ideological zealot and making money either for himself or for his associates”.

Emily Hilliard, an HHS spokesperson, said the department “categorically reject claims that Secretary Kennedy is pursuing personal gain or seeking to dismantle American medicine”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, prior to his confirmation hearing in january 2025, kennedy disclosed $2. 5m in income from referrals for vaccine-related lawsuits. In the hearing, Kennedy would not commit to forgoing compensation from vaccine lawsuits after he leaves office. Elizabeth Warren, a Democrat from Massachusetts, listed several ways in which Kennedy’s actions, some of which have now happened, could influence future litigation.

Diungkapkan bahwa “kennedy can kill off access to vaccines and make millions of dollars while he does it,” warren said at the hearing. “Kids might die. ” She pointed to Kennedy’s involvement in litigation against Merck for its HPV vaccine – lawsuits that were settled for more than $50m in June 2026. But Robert Kennedy can keep cashing in. After the confirmation hearing, Kennedy said his son would receive the money, expected to be 10% of the total; it’s unclear if he did.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “for most of us, money going to our children isn’t exactly money not going to us,” reiss said. “There’s a dozen ways he and his family could benefit” from Kennedy’s actions, she added.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kennedy has long profited from his anti-vaccine misinformation. Tony Lyons, Kennedy’s publisher and a central figure in the constellation of Maha political organizations, reportedly paid Kennedy $4m in book advances over the past year. The publisher also paid Kennedy $451,000 in consulting fees before he became HHS secretary. That’s on top of other book sales and paid speaking engagements over the years. Kennedy also earned $326,000 for the 15 weeks he served as chairman of Children’s Health Defense in 2023 – more than half of his $510,000 salary in 2022.

More recently, he received free flights and trips on a yacht from a former donor to his presidential campaign, who is now under investigation by the Senate for the gifts totaling some $250,000.

As HHS secretary, Kennedy has also loosened regulations on peptides, a booming part of the largely unregulated wellness industry.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “i think he’s doing what everyone knew he was going to do,” said hotez. Kennedy, before and during his tenure as leader of HHS, has been “chipping away at public confidence in vaccines and immunizations in favor of products that can be sold by the wellness industry”, he added.

Berdasarkan laporan, aaron siri, kennedy’s former lawyer who represents people who say they have experienced severe side effects, has advocated for changing all vaccines to “shared clinical decision-making”. If those changes took place, Siri could argue that the vaccines are not covered under the VICP and therefore open to litigation.

“A lot of what he is doing is geared toward setting up a more profitable litigation atmosphere,” Reiss said.

Siri did not respond to the Guardian’s question about profiting from litigation, but instead argued that “if vaccines are as ‘safe’ as touted by the government, then there should be no need for immunity to liability and, likewise, there should be very few, if any, successful cases”.

The most common claim to VICP – making up more than half – has to do with where the vaccine is administered, not the vaccines themselves.

Diungkapkan bahwa the vicp was established in 1986 in order to expedite compensation for anyone who experienced adverse side effects from vaccines. It’s very rare for people to develop severe side effects after vaccination, but when they do, they should be compensated, she said. There are real costs to undermining the program, Reiss said. But if false claims about vaccine harms proliferate, they will obscure those with legitimate claims.

Filing a VICP claim is an easier process than winning a lawsuit, which takes time and effort and also demands a higher burden of proof.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “that’s why the whole vaccine injury system was set up,” hotez said. “It was actually to the plaintiff’s benefit to get a faster judgment without having to show detailed evidence of proof. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa without vicp, patients would need to pay lawyers a large chunk of their settlements, if their case moves through the courts at all, reiss said: “the lack of contingency fee means they don’t have to pay 30% to 50% of their earnings through the lawyer. ”.

Compensating doctors for reporting side effects to the Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS) risks offering “the wrong incentives” to unscrupulous providers who could increase such activities to become a new revenue source, Reiss said.

The changes could “certainly” be used by organizations such as Children’s Health Defense to legitimize its work spreading misinformation “and convince donors and others that they should give them more money”, she added.

Sebagaimana diketahui, vaers, alongside several other vaccine monitoring systems, works well to pick up signals of very rare side effects, such as myocarditis from initial mrna covid vaccines and thrombotic thrombocytopenia in the johnson and johnson covid vaccine, hotez noted. But it’s not built to prove links between vaccines and certain side effects, as vaccination opponents have attempted to do, he said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “the vaers system was never meant to show cause and effect,” hotez said. But you have to analyze them. You look at every little blip, and almost all of them have nothing, are not real. “It’s like looking for signs of alien communication in outer space. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, years ago, hotez engaged kennedy in a series of conversations about misinformation that autism spectrum disorder is related to vaccines. Kennedy “had no interest then; he has no interest now”, Hotez said. So that’s his narrow interest, which has nothing to do with reality – and he’s still going by the same playbook. Hotez pointed to known environmental influences on autism, like the anti-seizure medication valproic acid. “Even back then, there was a heavy emphasis on being a plaintiff attorney and suing vaccine companies. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, kennedy has attacked medical journals and schools, and funding for medical research has fallen sharply under his leadership. Such actions appear intended to “completely wipe out American medicine as we know it in favor of this whole system of grifting and pseudoscience”, Hotez said.

#676. Black voters helped Democrats win in Georgia. Now they expect to be heard

📅 15 Nov 2026

Black voters helped Democrats win in Georgia. Now they expect to be heard

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/15/georgia-midterm-elections-black-voters

Activists have been shouting about economic issues for years – in January they will expect lawmakers to respond.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, stonecrest is resolutely middle class. About six out of 10 of its voters cast ballots in the 2026 election and about 90% of them voted for Democrats, according to election figures. And they have often been overlooked by Georgia’s Republican establishment.

Berdasarkan laporan, the fundraiser keisha lance bottoms held at the privi event center and retreat in suburban atlanta in september didn’t draw a lot of attention. But Stonecrest, by one measure the largest city in the United States with a non-Hispanic Black population above 90%, tends to roll under the radar.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s infuriating, said vaughn irons, privi’s founder. “I think she came to speak to a community that often gets driven through and flown over. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, black voting power helped secure victory for us senator jon ossoff, bottoms’ run for the governor’s race and a slew of down-ballot candidates. Now, those voters expect to be heard.

Sebagaimana diketahui, culture war issues come with the change in partisan control of georgia’s government; on abortion, on guns and on lgbtq+ rights. But the customary politics of Georgia start and end with business, and that attitude is bipartisan.

Berdasarkan laporan, georgia’s black voters have long wrestled with the black mecca paradox. Atlanta has long attracted Black professional talent from across the country and the world who were looking for strong African American political and cultural institutions and an economic environment perceived to give Black people an even shake.

Berdasarkan laporan, but upward mobility for native-born black atlantans has been anemic. Black unemployment rates are lower in Atlanta than the nation overall. Georgia leads the nation for Black executive representation and recent income growth. But Georgia offers the worst chances for wealth of any state for a Black child born into poverty.

Berdasarkan laporan, activists have stood on soapboxes to shout at georgia’s lawmakers about these economic issues for the last 20 years. In January, those voters will expect their government to answer them.

Berdasarkan laporan, the opinions of black voters – particularly black women – have been ignored for years, said tiffani stephens, a voter in dekalb county. We are of substance. “Where if you really know a Black woman, you know these are additives. Deep substance. “We’re taken as the pretty person and all we care about is clothes, shoes and makeup,” she said. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa democrats didn’t just win the marquee political contests in georgia this november. Almost all the statewide office holders will be Black women, including the incoming speaker of the Georgia house, state representative Carolyn Hugley of Columbus. They won every statewide election from the lieutenant governor’s office down to the insurance commissioner. Democrats displaced a Republican majority on the electricity rate-setting public service commission. Democrats are one state senator short of controlling both chambers.

Berdasarkan laporan, “this was not just a magical thing. This took a long time, building the infrastructure for the south and particularly for Georgia,” said Deborah Scott, executive director of Georgia STAND-UP, a “think and act tank” non-profit advocating for job training and economic development for working families.

Diungkapkan bahwa it has taken multiple failed election cycles, chipping away at layers of cynicism, to be ready for this moment, scott said. Stacey Abrams, two-time gubernatorial candidate turned democracy activist, deserves some credit for Georgia’s political results in November. But it is also the product of meticulous relationship-building groundwork, particularly by organizations led by Black women, she added.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “if stacey is the tree that all of these newly elected officials are sitting in, then the roots of that are community-based organizations and non-profit organizations like georgia stand-up and the people’s agenda, folks that have been doing the work for a long time. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa describing the election results as a referendum on gas prices, or the war, or donald trump, is reductive, scott said. Black voters assess their conditions holistically. “It’s not just about the gas prices are too damn high – which is true – but it’s also about the quality of life for regular Americans. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the last two years have been radicalizing for some georgia voters, scott said. While highly-educated CDC employees found themselves impaled on the spear tips of HHS secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr, nonprofits serving low-income communities like Scott’s have been scrambling to replace federal spending and a dearth of private grants, she said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, before the election, activists have been squabbling for scarce resources, she said. Today, they are bathing in the afterglow of political unity.

Berdasarkan laporan, for 20 years, democrats have been shut out of major decisions about georgia’s policy direction. The state has restrictive abortion laws and libertine gun laws. It is one of 10 states which did not expand access to Medicaid.

Diungkapkan bahwa it has also attracted stunning amounts of foreign investment during kemp’s two-terms in office, with car manufacturers, battery plants and chip makers locating to georgia. But almost all of that state-directed economic development landed either in the north Georgia foothills or in rural south Georgia, like the Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America manufacturing hub in Bryan county, rewarding white, Republican voters with jobs and political attention.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, scott speaks about the urgent need to encode voting rights protections in the georgia constitution with one breath. In the next, she talks about deepening the port of Savannah, or the new Audi car plant being built near Macon.

Berdasarkan laporan, “if you look at rural georgia versus urban and suburban georgia, it really is a tale of two states,” she said. Those that are born poor will not come out of it. There’s an opportunity for really affordable housing and real economic development. “This is an opportunity for economic development in all of the regions around Georgia … it’s an opportunity to equalize the state. It’s Atlanta and the rest of the state. And of course, even in Atlanta, it’s the tale of two cities. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the city of stonecrest, a suburb of south-eastern atlanta, exists as a municipality because its black, middle-class voters decided 10 years ago that they wanted their community to incorporate to serve them the way white middle-class voters are served 30 miles north in sandy springs. They wanted political leadership that matched their aspirations.

“As a small business owner, which I am, this is an opportunity to have a seat at the table,” said Kazemde Ajamu, who owns Akoma Coffee & Books at Stonecrest.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ajamu is looking for georgia to recognize microbusinesses and to better empower entrepreneurship for small business owners. “I feel good about the incoming governor-elect, that this gives us an opportunity to have a voice to speak to it, to create laws that help micro-businesses, mom-and-pops … That’s one example of having a seat at the table, having a voice, and someone that’s listening and can be proactive in that area. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, while democrats have control over the apparatus of state government, there is no reason to believe that’s a permanent condition. Political competition will force Bottoms and the state legislature to pay attention everywhere, Irons said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “everybody’s interest is in growing, and having prosperity and better education,” irons said. “The success of what’s likely to happen for the next governor is to create an environment where all parties that are serious about the growth and the prosperity of the state of Georgia can have a seat at the table. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the accession of bottoms as governor and democrats in control of government agencies may mean that a place like stonecrest is less likely to be overlooked, irons said. But the former HUD official and economic development director for DeKalb county said that doesn’t alone solve problems.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “i think every community has to be ready for the investment that it wants,” irons said. “And so you have a governor that you can access differently. I think Governor [Brian] Kemp probably was aware of the needs, but a different group of people had access, right? I think now that just because you have access doesn’t mean you don’t have your own responsibility to be ready. ”.

#682. Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'

Zelensky urges US and Musk to lift Starlink restrictions and be on 'right side of history'

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6m25zg88k45o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss

Restrictions have affected Ukraine's ability to intercept Russian missiles and drones.

A crucial US satellite internet service is still operating too slowly and affecting Ukraine's ability to stop Russian attacks, President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we are counting on these restrictions being lifted. The protection of lives and Ukraine's energy infrastructure ahead of winter directly depends on this," he said.

The issue over the speed of the Starshield system - a military-grade Starlink service owned by Elon Musk and provided to Ukraine by the US government - has been rumbling on for weeks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, zelensky said he had asked officials "to work as closely as possible" with the us government and musk's company. "It is important to be on the right side of history," he said. The BBC has asked the White House and Starlink for comment.

US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says.

Ukraine uses the normal Starlink service for communications on the battlefield, while Starshield is used for the interception of missiles and drones in Ukraine airspace.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the issue of speed restrictions was first identified in october. It led to conflicting accounts by both Elon Musk and US President Donald Trump.

Musk said the US government was responsible as Starshield was controlled by them, but Trump denied being responsible and said he had told the billionaire owner to "put it back".

It appeared to be returning to normal after a week, following which Ukraine said the restrictions were still being implemented.

The connection issues coincided with a tense diplomatic stand-off between Zelensky and Trump over Ukrainian strikes on oil infrastructure within Russia.

Trump said the strikes on Russian oil refineries, which Kyiv says are crucial to stemming the main revenue source for Moscow's war effort, had pushed global prices higher.

On Sunday Zelensky said Ukraine was struggling to intercept Russian jet-powered drones targeting electricity substations because "restrictions on the operating speed of Starshield terminals along the front line and in the temporarily occupied territories are still there".

"Our interceptor drones lose connection with their operators at a speed of 161km/h (100mph) and simply cannot catch up with Russian jet-powered 'shaheds'," he posted, referring to the drones that follow an Iranian design.

On Friday Zelensky said speed limits of around 100mph had been enforced on the network since Monday, but only in Russian-occupied areas and not the whole of Ukraine.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "it already has political implications. If you impose restrictions there, you are already partially recognising the temporary occupied territories as not ours," the New York Times reported him as saying.

Ukraine has also been beset by a shortage of US-made Patriot interceptors used to defend against Russian missiles - a situation that Russia has exploited to intensify strikes on Ukrainian targets.

Overnight and into Sunday morning Russia hit energy infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia and the Sumy, Odesa, Zhytomyr, and Kirovohrad regions, Ukraine said.

It also struck railway infrastructure in the Dnipro, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia regions.

Scores of people are said to have been hurt in those attacks, as well as two in the Donetsk and Kyiv regions.

Two people were killed in an attack on an infrastructure facility in Chernihiv Region's Mena, governor Vyacheslav Chaus said.

Multiple strikes were also delivered on energy facilities across the region, he added on Telegram.

Ukraine meanwhile said it had carried out strikes on a petrochemical plant and an oil refinery in the central Russian city of Nizhnekamsk.

"On the night of November 15, units of Ukraine's Defence Forces reached Nizhnekamsk in Tatarstan," the military said on Telegram.

Berdasarkan laporan, "two enterprises that feed the russian war with raw materials and fuel came under attack. ".

Other Ukrainian strikes killed one person in Taganrog, an industrial port city near the border, regional governor Yuri Slyusar said.

In the occupied Luhansk region a lorry driver and an elderly woman were also killed, Leonid Pasechnik, the regional leader installed by Moscow said.

Meanwhile Estonia has announced it will shut its border crossing points with Russia from 1 December following a suspected sabotage attack on a defence company.

Eight people were detained over an attempted arson attack on drone maker Threod Systems.

Berdasarkan laporan, the estonian authorities say they had been ordered by russia's gru military intelligence service to try and carry out the attack. Russia has not commented.

"Russia must understand that hostile actions against Estonia come with consequences," Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna said.

Australia, UK, Canada and Italy urge Israel to allow critical aid to Gaza ahead of winter

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/16/australia-uk-canada-italy-urge-israel-critical-aid-gaza-winter-ntwnfb

Four countries call situation ‘entirely reversible’ in joint statement as flooding exacerbates humanitarian crisis.

Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom and Italy have urged Israel to allow critical humanitarian aid to enter Gaza, describing the situation on the ground as “dire”.

The four countries released a joint statement on Monday morning, urging Israel to allow 150,000 tents and other vital supplies being held at the border into Gaza ahead of winter.

“We, the Foreign Ministers of Australia, Canada, Italy and the United Kingdom, are clear that as winter takes hold in Gaza, the humanitarian situation on the ground is dire,” the statement said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “the recent floods have brought further suffering – and this was only the first storm of the winter. People in Gaza desperately need shelter and humanitarian assistance. ”.

The ministers said Israel has time to act “before the winter fully sets in”.

“This situation is entirely reversible … we today urge the government of Israel to stop the delays now and allow immediate, rapid and unimpeded humanitarian access throughout Gaza,” the foreign ministers said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “the crossings must be opened, and the tents allowed in. Dual-use items necessary for humanitarian operations and early recovery must be granted entry before it is too late. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, tens of thousands of palestinians in gaza have been left in waterlogged and damaged tents after deadly storms in the past week. Thousands more have been left without shelter while sanitation infrastructure has also been destroyed by storms.

At least four Palestinian children and woman were killed as heavy rains and wind battered fragile, leaky tents.

Australia’s Greens leader and foreign affairs spokesperson, David Shoebridge, said “harsh words” from the government would do little, and that the government should instead take more concrete action.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the israeli government has not responded to harsh words from australia before, they won’t now. Material action, sanctions on the war cabinet, ending the two-way arms trade, implementing sanctions on illegal settlements as other nations have done. These are real actions the Albanese Government can take but has failed to,” Shoebridge said.

Shoebridge said Australia previously refused to join commitments by multiple allies including the UK that called for import bans on trade from illegal Israeli settlements.

“When it was a statement committing to material action, Australia disappeared,” Shoebridge said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the foreign ministers urged all parties to implement the comprehensive plan for gaza, respect the ceasefire and “their obligations under international humanitarian law, and allowing aid to reach the people who need it. ”.

On Monday, Australian cabinet minister Madeleine King told ABC radio the four nations had worked on the statement.

“This particular group has been working on this kind of statement for a little while to make sure that people that are affected by the war in the Middle East can receive the assistance they need,” she said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “but, really importantly … is the fact that this humanitarian aid will be able to be delivered. ”.

#687. South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating

📅 15 Nov 2026

South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckvg2ezvpe08o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss

Han Won-seok confessed in a video on the YouTube channel of his lawyer.

A candidate who came first in South Korea's certified tax accountancy exam has admitted cheating by using a miniature camera, mobile phone and AI tools.

Han Won-seok confessed in a video on the YouTube account of his lawyer, Lee Don-Ho, adding that he had confessed to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency and offered details on how he cheated.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the 34-year-old scored 397. 5 out of 400 points in the first round, getting just one of 160 questions wrong, which initially raised suspicions and sparked online speculation.

Standardised national tests play an outsized role in career trajectories for South Koreans, making their results - and efforts to unduly inflate those results - of great importance.

"I cheated in both the first and second rounds of the tax account exam by using electronic devices and generative AI," Han said in the video published on Sunday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i used a microcamera to photograph the test questions and sent them to an ai then checked my answers on my smartphone to commit the cheating. ".

When accusations he had cheated first began to surface, Han had denied any wrongdoing - but said he had changed his mind after thinking about the feelings of the candidate who had come second in the exam.

He went on to apologise to the other entrants who had passed the tests fairly.

"It seems that because of me, other successful candidates are being suspected," he suggested.

The Ministry of Employment and Labour and the Human Resources Development Service held an emergency meeting after Han admitted cheating.

The South Korean president's policy chief Ha Jun-kyung said new measures would be introduced to prevent cheating and warned "past crimes" would be "tracked down and apprehended to the very end".

Those found to have used AI to cheat in the tax accountancy exam will have their qualification revoked and will be banned from retaking the test for five years, the government said.

The scandal comes just days before the east Asian nation's annual college entrance exam, a crucial hurdle for students.

Can smart glasses exam cheating be stopped?.

A series of cases involving exam cheating with AI glasses in South Korea has universities and schools scrambling to rein in the use of the technology.

Han said he had only cheated to try and earn money and get a job that would make his parents proud of him again.

Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency told Korean news agency Yonhap on Sunday that it was looking into the case.

"We received a written confession through the test taker's lawyer this morning regarding cheating on the tax accountant exam," it confirmed in a statement.

It added that the case had now been assigned to investigators.

Because of the significance of the national exams, instances of cheating are not uncommon in South Korea, and cases involving the use of AI have become more prominent as the technology becomes more sophisticated.

Last month, two college applicants were reported to have used AI glasses to try and cheat their entrance exams at two Seoul universities.

Education ministry data also says there were four cases of cheating through AI glasses at middle and high schools in the past 12 months.

Exams watchdog warns of rise in high-tech cheating.

#690. Gender-diverse Australian sailors barred from US submarines despite Aukus deal, documents reveal

📅 15 Nov 2026

Gender-diverse Australian sailors barred from US submarines despite Aukus deal, documents reveal

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/nov/16/gender-diverse-australian-sailors-barred-from-us-submarines-despite-aukus-deal-documents-reveal-ntwnfb

Defence briefing released under freedom of information laws shows ADF beholden to US directives when in training.

Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast.

Aukus is effectively forcing the Australian navy to comply with a US ban on transgender people in the military with gender-diverse navy recruits prevented from starting a career in nuclear submarines because they would not be safe training on US boats.

Internal Australian defence force documents show transgender and non-binary sailors and officers are explicitly banned from Australia’s nuclear submarine training program because of US policies.

An internal defence briefing, released under freedom of information laws, said while ADF policy on equality and inclusion was unchanged, “US government policy is different”.

“ADF personnel undertaking duty in the US (including training) are required to comply with US policy,” the briefing said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “consequently, transgender and nonbinary adf personnel and adf career applicants are currently unable to commence the ssn [nuclear-powered attack submarines] training pathway. ”.

Australia, without a nuclear submarine fleet of its own, has hundreds of sailors and officers training on US nuclear submarines and on US bases.

At a women in defence event in October, Rear Adm Tish van Stralen was asked how the defence force was “managing the recruitment of gender-diverse and LGBTQ+ Australians into the nuclear submarine pathway” given the US directive.

Van Stralen, one of the highest-ranking women in the Australian navy, said the ADF was a diverse and equal opportunity employer.

But she said potential recruits for the nuclear submarine program were told the ADF was “subject to policies and laws in other countries, so we have to be very mindful”.

“We also have an obligation, a duty of care to our people, so we do not want to put our people into any sort of harm’s way or anything that might adversely affect them.

Diungkapkan bahwa “i’m working very closely with navy at the moment and with the submarine agency around the training opportunities because it would be very difficult for me to put a gender-diverse person into that training at the moment. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, van stralen said the navy would seek alternative career paths for gender-diverse recruits prohibited from the nuclear submarine program. She said the UK, Australia’s other Aukus partner, had “more liberal policies” and that training opportunities “may arise in the UK”.

Berdasarkan laporan, “we don’t want to disadvantage people because of it but we are subject to the laws and policies of the us when we are in their country. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the us defence secretary, pete hegseth, last year issued a directive to his department “to eliminate all diversity, equity and inclusion offices and initiatives”. He also has sought to ban transgender personnel from joining the US military – repeatedly using offensive slurs in public statements – and ordered that transgender personnel be purged from the services.

Donald Trump signed an executive order in January 2025 – the first week of his second term as president – which banned transgender service personnel and said gender-diverse people were unfit to serve.

Announcing military cuts in September amid continued attacks on diversity, Hegseth declared that the US military would accept “no fatties, no trannies, no beardos, no weirdos, no wimps, no radicals”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, under the aukus deal, it is proposed that australia will buy three virginia-class nuclear submarines from the us, beginning in 2032. In the lead-up to that, Australian sailors are training onboard US Virginia-class submarines and at US bases, while US-flagged nuclear submarines are porting in Australia.

Berdasarkan laporan, crewing australia’s proposed nuclear submarine fleet is likely to prove one of the aukus agreement’s most critical, sustained challenges. Virginia-class submarines have a complement of 135, more than double the crew for Australia’s diesel-electric Collins-class submarines.

Last week Australia’s defence minister, Richard Marles, said the Aukus timeline presented the country with a significant “training challenge”.

“We just need to be training more people and that’s what we’re doing,” Marles said at HMAS Stirling, the West Australian port through which US nuclear-powered submarines have been rotating.

The Australian defence department did not respond to questions from the Guardian about the impact of adhering to the US policy directive, including how many Australian service personnel have been prevented from undertaking nuclear submarine training.

The government’s nuclear-powered submarine workforce strategy urges defence to “proactively expand the talent pool through active inclusion of underrepresented groups, including women, First Nations Australians, regional communities, and individuals who may not traditionally see themselves in technical or defence-related careers”.

#695. Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says

📅 15 Nov 2026

Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmdx1vpprk9vo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss

The Nvidia scandal has sent shockwaves through Silicon Valley as well as the political establishment.

Alice Huang, a suspected China spy who has been linked to Nvidia's former boss Jensen Huang, left her executive role at Megaspeed in August last year, the company says.

Jensen Huang resigned as chief executive of the AI chip-making giant Nvidia after it emerged he had allegedly had affairs with Alice Huang as well as with one of his employees.

Megaspeed is the biggest buyer of Nvidia chips in South East Asia and the scandal at Nvidia has raised questions about the possibility that high-end AI chips may have ended up in China despite US export restrictions.

The Singapore-based company said on Sunday it had launched an internal investigation into its business.

Megaspeed said it was aware of reports "containing assertions about our business, supply chain and global operations that are not supported by verifiable evidence".

It added that it "conducts legitimate and lawful business" and has "retained external legal counsel to conduct a thorough internal investigation".

Also on Sunday, US Congressman John Moolenaar said that Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before the Select Committee on China, which he chairs, as well as the House Foreign Affairs and the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence.

The committee heads had threatened to issue subpoenas to Huang if he did not comply with their requests to testify.

Berdasarkan laporan, moolenaar told cbs, bbc's us partner, that none were ultimately issued. Huang's testimony is expected to take place behind close doors, with the dates still being finalised.

"That's going to be a very important meeting to understand to what degree privileged information was accessed, and to what degree this potential alleged Chinese spy influenced Nvidia's philosophy and may have had an influence on some of our policies with respect to AI and export controls," the congressman told the Face The Nation programme.

Separately, a group of tech leaders, including Space X's Elon Musk, have been trying to rally support to have Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO.

A representative for Huang declined to comment on a report in the Financial Times Sunday suggesting that he was discussing a comeback to the firm he co-founded.

On Friday, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent blamed fellow Trump cabinet colleague Howard Lutnick's commerce department for failing to properly oversee the export of high-end chips.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bessent told cnbc that several agencies "were in favour of putting megaspeed on the entity list for months. but Commerce has the pen. and you will have to ask them about their internal process".

The so-called entity list restricts US trade with overseas firms and individuals.

Lutnick has been called to testify before the Senate Banking Committee next month over his department's role in allowing Nvidia to export its advanced chips.

Other congressional committees have asked both Lutnick and his department to retain all records relating to Nvidia and Jensen Huang.

Megaspeed is suspected of giving backdoor access to Nvidia chips to Chinese companies via its data centres in Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand.

Watch: Who is suspected Chinese spy at centre of Nvidia affair investigation?.

Nvidia has been banned from selling its advanced chips to China.

While Singapore does not prohibit the transfer of advanced AI chips to companies abroad, such moves can breach US export controls.

Singapore has said that while it does not enforce "unilateral export controls imposed by other countries" it expects all companies in its jurisdiction to respect such regulations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, megaspeed said it "designs and maintains its global operational and supply-chain control frameworks to comply with all applicable laws and regulatory regimes". It said this includes "US export control requirements and local jurisdiction rules in every market where we operate".

China has denied that Alice Huang is a spy and warned the US not to use the scandal as a "pretext for imposing a technological blockade" on AI technology.

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm8e0knr7604o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss

Organisers said around 400,000 people took part on Sunday.

Thousands of people have gathered in central Prague to protest against the Czech government's plans to scrap the licence fee and use the state budget to fund public media.

Critics say the plans would allow politicians to stifle media freedom.

The coalition government - which consists of the populist ANO party and two right-wing Eurosceptic parties - insists the change will not affect editorial independence, but wants broadcasters to cut costs.

Berdasarkan laporan, parliament passed the first draft of the proposal late last month. Since then, thousands of Czechs have taken part in protests.

Diungkapkan bahwa czech households currently pay â 205 crowns ($9. 44; Â£7. 06) a month for public TV and radio.

Sunday's protest was organised by the Million Moments for Democracy association which said "roughly 400,000" people had attended.

"I know that our entire Czech Television is a guarantee of truth and objectivity," pensioner Milana Rudolfova, 72, told Reuters news agency.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "if we do not have public television and radio then unfortunately we will not be able to believe anything anymore. ".

The protesters say the planned changes could allow politicians to stifle media freedom.

Prime Minister Andrej Babis has insisted the government does not want to control public media.

"The funding system is changing, no one wants to control public media, no one wants to dictate to them what they should say and do, no one wants to nationalise them," Babis told the Czech News Agency.

"We are doing this because the system is already outdated and most of Europe is going the same way today and others are joining in," he added.

Some European countries, including France and Norway, have moved away from the public licence fee model in the last few years.

France removed it in 2022 and its public media, which also carries advertising, is now funded by a portion of the income from VAT.

Norway abolished its license fee in 2020 and moved its public broadcaster's funding into the national budget.

Reuters said the proposal would amount to a 15% cut in funding for the public broadcasters Czech TV and Czech Radio.

These protesters held a sign depicting the animated character Vecernicek and saying "We stand with Czech TV".

Some protesters wore pointed hats folded out of newspapers as a tribute to an animated character, Vecernicek, who has introduced Czech Television's nightly children's bedtime stories for decades.

Critics have compared the government's media bill to changes in Hungary under former Prime Minister Viktor OrbÃ¡n, who tightly controlled state media when he was in power.

Prime Minister Andrej Babis was appointed in December in 2025, and has faced criticism over his coalition's attacks on Czech media.

"Political attacks against private and public media have become one of the hallmarks of Andrej Babis' premiership," said Pavol Szalai, Prague Bureau director of international press freedom organisation Reporters Without Borders, in June.

Authorities say Russian intelligence service ordered attack which Estonian PM links to Tallinn’s support for Ukraine.

Estonia will close all its border crossings with Russia from 1 December after a suspected sabotage attack on a drone maker in the Baltic state over the weekend, which authorities said was ordered by Russia’s GRU military intelligence service.

Berdasarkan laporan, on saturday morning, eight people were detained during an attempted attack on threod systems, a defence company that manufactures long-range attack and reconnaissance drones. No injuries or damage were reported after the company’s security team responded to the incident.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, estonia’s internal security service, kapo, said on sunday the attack was carried out “with the aim of causing an explosion and setting the building on fire”. Authorities have requested a court order for five of those detained to remain in custody, Estonia’s public broadcaster ERR reported.

The Estonian prime minister, Kristen Michal, said the border closure was needed to reduce the risk of further attacks and “send a clear message that attacks on Estonia’s defence industry and defence capabilities” were unacceptable.

Berdasarkan laporan, he linked the attacks with estonia’s continuing support for ukraine. “Russia’s aim is to make us afraid, make us hesitate and weaken our support for Ukraine,” Michal said.

Berdasarkan laporan, “estonia’s response is the opposite. We will strengthen our security, work even more closely with businesses and our allies, increase pressure on Russia and continue supporting Ukraine. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the estonian foreign minister, margus tsahkna, echoed the warning, saying: “russia must understand that hostile actions against estonia come with consequences. Attempts to intimidate, destabilise or undermine our security will not go unanswered. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, estonia operates three border crossings with russia – narva in the north, and koidula and luhamaa in the south. The authorities did not specify how long the closure would be.

It is the second attempted attack on an Estonian defence company that authorities have attributed to Russia, after an arson attack at Milrem Robotics in August.

In September, Kapo said it was confident that the incident was “a deliberate and pre-planned attack carried out on behalf of Russian special services”.

The agency also said it fitted a pattern of Russian attacks targeting defence and drone companies, particularly those with links to Ukraine.

At the time Estonia summoned Russia’s chargé d’affaires over the attack, but the Kremlin denied any link to Russia, saying it was a “baseless” and “ill-considered” accusation “with absolutely no relation to reality”.

Several European intelligence services have repeatedly warned of potential attacks on defence companies and growing Russian attempts to recruit citizens in EU and Nato countries – on online messaging platforms – to carry out acts of sabotage.

Berdasarkan laporan, michal noted that the weekend’s arrests came after security agencies told the defence industry of potential risks. “We do not warn about these threats without reason. Preparedness matters, and this time it clearly paid off,” he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the russian foreign ministry spokesperson, maria zakharova, told state news agency tass: “if ‌these [border closures] are ‌their real plans, then ‌they fit into yet another bout of aggressive and unrestrained russophobia. ”.

Some 106,000 people from a wide range of groups took to the streets in France on Saturday, including 24,000 in Paris.

Police in Paris have issued a five-day ban on protests near 10 secondary schools and five universities as authorities try to control weeks of blockades and violence at educational venues in France.

The order prohibits unauthorised gatherings or marches within 100m of the sites from 16 to 20 November.

Paris police chief Patrice Faure said the ban was necessary due to "numerous disruptions and blockades around certain secondary schools and establishments of higher learning" and "persistent violence".

A wave of protests began in France September over poor secondary school conditions, before spreading to universities, workers and a "yellow-vest" movement against the cost of living.

Announcing the order, the Paris police chief said blockades around certain secondary schools and universities have led to damaged public property, violence against members of the educational community and clashes with law enforcement.

Mayors of eight Parisian districts had contacted the regional education authority to call for measures to "secure the entrances and exits" of blockaded secondary schools, local media report.

Some 1,548 people have been arrested in Paris since the start of the protests, Faure said on Sunday.

Riot police clash with demonstrators in Paris on Saturday.

On Saturday, 106,000 people from a range of groups took to the streets in France, including 24,000 in Paris, the interior ministry said.

It marked the fifth Saturday in a row where students, unions and yellow-vest activists went out to protest.

The number of protesters was much lower than previously, and so was the number of those arrested, the ministry said - 219 across the country, including 45 in Paris.

#708. Clothing factories shut in Bangladesh as workers strike over pay

Clothing factories shut in Bangladesh as workers strike over pay

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx5y1pzr9604o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss

Protesters in Dhaka, Bangladesh, on Friday demanding a new minimum wage.

Dozens of factories in Bangladesh's main clothes-producing area have been shut by workers striking over a higher minimum wage.

Nearly 150 sites across the country have been closed in the textile hubs of Savar, Ashulia and Gazipur this weekend.

The garment industry is big business for Bangladesh, generating nearly $40bn (Â£30bn) in exports every year and making up 10% of the country's total GDP.

Diungkapkan bahwa workers are striking over demands for a minimum wage of 30,000 taka (â£182) a month. The minimum monthly wage in Bangladesh is currently 12,500 taka but employees say this is not enough to deal with the cost of living crisis.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on sunday morning workers massed on the dhaka-tangail highway in gazipur to block the road. Traffic was stopped by the protests for about an hour before police stepped in.

A "No Work No Pay" provision of labour laws allows owners to suspend operations and withhold wages when production is disrupted.

Police Supt Mohammad Amjad Hossain told the BBC officers shut factories in the city after the workers walked out.

He said 13 factories were closed on Saturday night and "sixteen factories were closed during the morning unrest".

Wage protests force hundreds of Bangladesh garment factories to close.

The garment industry in Bangladesh employs about four million workers making clothes for big brands including H&M, Primark and Zara.

Bangladesh is the world's second largest exporter of ready- to-wear clothes after China and it is feared that the current unrest could have a knock-on effect for international buyers if it carries on for substantial amount of time.

The Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BGMEA) and the Bangladesh Knitwear Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BKMEA) is calling for protection for factories.

"BGMEA and BKMEA have questioned the justification of continuing to participate in wage board negotiations without any assurance that the factories will be protected," BGMEA President Mahmud Hasan Khan said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "garment factories that have been unable to continue production due to the ongoing unrest will remain indefinitely closed from tomorrow under. Bangladesh's labour law. ".

On 1 November the government formed a minimum wage board to recommend a revised pay structure for workers.

The board, chaired by a senior district judge, said at its first meeting it would finalise any recommendations by the end of November.

Once it is put in place, the revised pay structure is expected to take effect from 1 December.

#710. Thousands of US flights still cancelled or delayed two days after grounding of planes nationwide

📅 15 Nov 2026

Thousands of US flights still cancelled or delayed two days after grounding of planes nationwide

Tanggal: 15 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cw1mdlv0k2r4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss

'We'll get home one day' - US travellers impacted by nationwide ground stop.

Thousands of US flights were cancelled or delayed on Sunday as the US air-traffic control system continued to recover from a technical failure that led to a rare national ground stop.

Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy said normal operations may not be restored until Monday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "we have airplanes and crews that are out of position, so it takes a little bit of time," he told the bbc's us partner cbs. More than 5,000 flights were delayed and 2,000 cancelled on Sunday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, president donald trump urged congress on sunday to approve more money to modernise the air-traffic control system. The grounding of all aircraft scheduled to depart the US on Friday caused chaos at airports across the country.

Diungkapkan bahwa more than 3,500 airplanes were in the air when the faa announced at 15:54 est (20:54 gmt) that flights would be grounded until further notice. Some were diverted to other airports and others flew on to their destinations.

In the aftermath, 8,500 flights were delayed and another 8,000 cancelled, according to FlightAware.

Diungkapkan bahwa the stoppage left passengers stuck inside planes on the tarmac, unable to take off or to return to their gates. Others were stranded in airports, sleeping on the floor and desperately trying to get in touch with their airline. The ground stop also had a knock-on effect on schedules around the world, with some flights out of the UK and Europe cancelled.

The ground stop was lifted after about four and a half hours, but the impacts continued over the weekend.

On Saturday, airlines cancelled more than 5,900 flights and more than 7,000 others were delayed.

Investigators are still working to determine the root cause and who is at fault, but Duffy said the administration decided to ground flights after failures in a key system that allows air traffic controllers and pilots to communicate.

The transport secretary said a computer router installed as part of an upgrade from copper wire to fibre started sending out faulty signals.

He said on Sunday that the router - a piece of equipment which directs traffic across the network - was installed in El Dorado, Arkansas, and "flooded our network".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, duffy said that issues will continue to arise until the us makes major modernising changes to its air control system. The system needs a complete overhaul, he said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "let's not lie to each other," he said on nbc's meet the press. "We have to make investments into a network that has been neglected for decades. ".

In a post on Truth Social on Sunday, Trump urged US lawmakers to allocate the money, saying "we can get it built quickly and efficiently".

Diungkapkan bahwa "it will be the best system anywhere in the world. Much of our current air control system is 50 years old - RIDICULOUS! We have already started the work, but it should be done all at once, not in drips and drabs," he said.

Experts say the US uses antiquated technology for flight communications.

Aviation analyst Miles O'Brien described the US system as "a house that's about to be condemned".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he told the bbc: "i think most of us could look at this and go 'this is a system in the united states that we have allowed to decay'. It is worse than a fixer-upper. ".

Iran and the US are vying for control of the Strait of Hormuz.

Iran launched a drone attack against a US military base in Bahrain on Sunday, its second attempt to target the country in three days.

The country's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said it targeted the US air defence radar facility at al-Riffa air base in Bahrain using six drones.

Bahrain's military said its air defence systems intercepted and destroyed the Iranian air attacks "before they could achieve their objectives".

It comes after Iran fired drones at Bahrain on Friday, its first attack against Gulf countries since September.

Berdasarkan laporan, the us and iran are locked in a stand-off over the strait of hormuz. About a fifth of the world's gas and oil supply usually flows through it but shipping has been restricted since the outbreak of war in February.

Iran insists that it should control the strait and has been attacking what it calls "unauthorised" traffic, while the US military is providing protection for tankers shuttling oil through the strait to keep exports flowing from Gulf Arab states.

As sirens sounded across Bahrain on Sunday the interior ministry called on citizens to head to their nearest safe location.

Sebagaimana diketahui, bahrain's foreign ministry said: "the kingdom of bahrain condemns in the strongest terms the continued brutal iranian attacks on its territory and holds iran fully responsible for their consequences. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in a statement on the strikes shared by iran's state broadcaster on telegram, the irgc said: "the strait of hormuz is closed, and any aggression by the american enemy will be met with an even harsher and more forceful response. ".

Earlier this week, the IRGC claimed that it struck a US early warning radar system in Bahrain on Friday.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the us military has denied the claim, stating that the irgc launched two one-way attack drones towards bahrain and both were shot down by us forces. It added that there were no injuries or damage.

Earlier in the week the US carried out strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, US officials told CBS, the BBC's US partner.

The officials described the strikes as limited and defensive, and said they were in response to the IRGC firing on a US aircraft.

Sebagaimana diketahui, iranian state news agency irna reported explosions on qeshm on monday. The IRGC did not comment but said its forces had shot down two US MQM-170 drones south of the island and a US MQ-9 drone east of the Strait.

The US and Iran reached a preliminary agreement to end the war and reopen the strait in June, but it collapsed within weeks after Iranian attacks on shipping resumed and the US reinstated a naval blockade of Iranian ports.

Iranian negotiators had been discussing with mediators a proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if the US meets seven conditions, reportedly including the lifting of the naval blockade and releasing frozen Iranian assets.

However this week Donald Trump said that the US was no longer interested in a deal to end the war with Iran and ordered Vice-President JD Vance, who had been involved in efforts to restart negotiations, to focus on domestic US politics.

Iran has launched drone attacks against a US military base in Bahrain, casting further doubt on peace talks between Tehran and Washington and raising the spectre of escalation.

Blasts sounded over the Gulf nation on Sunday in the second Iranian drone attack in three days in retaliation for US strikes in Iran.

Diungkapkan bahwa meanwhile, in yemen, iran’s houthi allies advanced against pro-government forces in the south, opening a potential route to aden. Iran also claimed that a mine sank an oil supertanker in the strait of Hormuz.

The developments deepened gloom about the chances of any diplomatic breakthrough in the region.

Sebagaimana diketahui, iran’s islamic revolutionary guards corps said they launched six drones targeting a us air defence radar at the al-rifaa helicopter base in retaliation for “hostile us actions”. Authorities in Bahrain said air defences intercepted the drones before they reached their targets.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at a press conference in tehran the foreign ministry spokesperson, esmaeil baghaei, said iran would continue to respond to any military aggression by the us or other states. Asked if the latest strikes indicated a change in Iranian direction as negotiations with the US have stalled, he said Iran was “not waiting for anyone” and was focused on its security.

US forces have conducted a series of strikes against Iranian targets in recent weeks, including Qeshm Island in the strait of Hormuz.

Donald Trump last week called them minor strikes and said Saudi Arabia and other Gulf states had cautioned him against large-scale combat operations.

However, the president also said Washington was no longer seeking a deal with Iran and that he had instructed the vice-president, JD Vance, to switch his focus to alleged corruption and fraud in Democrat-run cities and states.

Vance – who blamed the Republicans’ loss of Congress in midterm elections on the Iran war – had requested a personal meeting with Iranian negotiators to discuss peace terms.

A conflict that began with joint US and Israeli attacks against Iran in February remains at an impasse, with the US maintaining a naval blockade and Iran its chokehold over the strait of Hormuz.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a separate development, iran’s revolutionary guards claimed that two ships hit mines in the strait of hormuz and that one, an oil supertanker with 2m barrels of oil, sank. The ships suffered “massive explosions and fire”, said the statement.

Berdasarkan laporan, there was no immediate independent verification. The US military recently claimed it had cleared all mines from main routes through the waterway.

The strikes against Bahrain suggested Iran has decided on a tit-for-tat response to US attacks.

Bahrain hosts significant US bases, including a forward base that was home to the US Fifth Fleet and US Naval Forces Central Command, operating as a central support hub for military operations in the Middle East.

Berdasarkan laporan, tehran repeatedly targeted the kingdom until september, when there was a lull in attacks. That ended on Friday when Iran launched drones against a US radar facility. US Central Command said it shot down two drones without any injury or damage.

The attacks on Sunday prompted sirens and alerts from Bahrain’s authorities urging residents to seek shelter.

“It’s exactly what I was hoping wouldn’t happen: Iranian attacks starting again, with all the worry and uncertainty that go with them,” resident Hayat Ibrahim, 65, told Agence France Presse.

Bahrain’s foreign ministry called the resumption of attacks “heinous aggression” and a flagrant violation of international law.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the kingdom rejected tehran’s “flimsy pretexts and baseless claims” to target its territory, it said in a statement. “The kingdom also rejects the transformation of its territory into an arena for settling scores and holds Iran fully responsible for these attacks and their consequences. ”.

Jordan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar condemned the attacks and expressed solidarity with Bahrain.

In Yemen, Saudi Arabia’s campaign against the Iranian-aligned Houthi rebels reeled when forces fighting on behalf of the Yemeni government retreated from the Bab el-Mandeb strait to defend ⁠Aden on the southern ​coast.

“The Southern Armed Forces announce the implementation of ‌a redeployment operation for its forces from Dhubab Airport and the Bab el-Mandeb area, west of Taiz Governorate,” the main military force fighting for Yemen’s government in the south said in a statement.

The admission signalled the apparent failure of a six-week government counteroffensive to drive the Houthis from the mouth of the Red Sea to secure a key oil route.

A Houthi missile strike near Aden killed people and wounded 12 near Aden, AFP reported, citing military and government sources.

Ronaldinho played the first 45 minutes for Ravenna against Forli.

Brazil legend Ronaldinho made his comeback aged 46 for Ravenna in their 2-0 win over Forli in an Italian third-tier derby.

The 46-year-old came out of retirement for the Serie C club he joined as an investor in August, having last played in 2015 for Fluminense.

He started Sunday's game and showed some bright touches, and he was involved in the opening goal.

The former Barcelona superstar held off a defender before playing the pass that came before the assist for Giulio Donati's drive from outside the box.

He had earlier set up a chance for Donati from a corner, with the defender having his header saved.

At half-time there was a media circus around Ronaldinho, with journalists surrounding him, and former Brazil and AC Milan team-mate Dida joined him on the pitch.

Ronaldinho was substituted at the break with the score at 1-0.

A temporary stand, named the R10 in reference to Ronaldinho and his familiar shirt number, was built for the sold-out fixture at the Stadio Bruno Benelli.

The game was streamed in several countries around the world.

Ronaldinho trained once with the team, on Saturday, before Sunday's debut.

A team graphic beforehand showed him on the left side, but he mostly played centrally.

In his peak playing years, Ronaldinho was one of the best players in the world - as well as one of the most popular for his joyful demeanour and exuberant skill.

He won the 2002 World Cup with Brazil, the 2006 Champions League with Barcelona, and league titles with Barca and AC Milan - plus the Ballon d'Or and Fifa World Player of the Year awards in 2005.

He also played for Paris St-Germain as well as Gremio, Flamengo, Atletico Mineiro and Fluminense in his homeland, plus Mexican side Queretaro.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ronaldinho scored 299 goals in his regular career and had been hoping to have a chance for number 300 for ravenna. He would have taken a penalty had they been awarded one.

"It was lovely to be here, playing, having the build-up in the dressing room," Ronaldinho told Sky Sport Italia.

Berdasarkan laporan, and asked if he might play again for ravenna, who are second in their serie c group, he said: "if the president calls me, i'll be back. ".
